title: SpeechAsr
description: What was said, from a recognizer batched over voice activity (book ch. 13). The utterance intervals are decode-window hints. A recognizer with an acoustic duration head may also supply measured word intervals and declare transducer timing. Other recognizers defer all word placement to forced alignment.

audio_artifact_id.description: The 16 kHz mono rendition this pass decoded, verified before use.

vad_artifact_id.description: The voice activity that bounded the decode. Recorded because re-running with different speech boundaries is a different observation.

language.description: BCP 47 primary subtag of the recognized language.

decoding.description: How the text was produced. Greedy decoding at temperature zero is not a quality preference — it is what makes two runs of the same audio agree, which is what lets a cached transcript be trusted.

conditioned_on_previous.description: Whether each window saw the previous window's text. False keeps one bad window from poisoning the rest.

initial_prompt_digest.description: Digest of any vocabulary hint given to the decoder, so a hinted transcript is never confused with an unhinted one.

timing_authority.description: The source of word timing. Only an acoustic duration model may emit transducer_words. Window hints are never word timing.

invalid_regions.description: Speech the recognizer could not turn into text. Explicit, because a downstream stage reading a gap as silence would place a cut in the middle of a sentence.

vad_segment_index.description: Which speech segment this decode covered.

hint_start_ticks.description: Decoder bookkeeping, not word timing. Useful for batching and progress; never for cutting.

transducer_words.description: Measured intervals in source ticks from an acoustic duration head, in transcript order. A zero-duration emission has no measured interval.

tokens.description: Per-token confidences, kept because a segment average hides the one hallucinated proper noun that ranking would otherwise quote.

confidence.description: A distribution, not a scalar: p10 is what the segment is worth if the model is having a bad time, and downstream stages that widen uncertainty need both numbers.

coverage.description: What was actually decoded. Speech the pass never reached is not speech that turned out to be empty.

decoded_ticks.description: Speech duration actually handed to the recognizer.
